reasons.correctness: getTicketStats counts every TicketStatus with start/end as specified. Throws ValidationTranslatableException with error.validation.invalid_date_range. Non-admin gets the same InsufficientPermissionsException as updateTicketStatus. Endpoint matches /admin/stats. 5/5 hidden tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: Endpoint has @PreAuthorize (ADMIN) and @RateLimit. Response is a *DtoOut. New key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. Error is a TranslatableException subclass. New *UnitTest uses MockitoExtension. Nothing touched outside the feature package.
reasons.design_fit: Uses the existing permissionUtils/InsufficientPermissionsException pattern and the derived repository query. Smell: the GDPR access log line appears in both controller getTicketStats and service getTicketStats, so each call logs it twice.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketServiceStatsUnitTest covers per-status counts and total, exact start/end arguments, all-zero case, inverted range, and non-admin. Error tests assert message keys and that the repository is never called. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the support-package files, their TESTED_BY tests and their dependents before any read. The agent then read the controller, service, repository and existing unit tests that the queries surfaced, and edited those files.
